nodes.name: inbox_wake.rs
nodes.summary: Production InboxWakeHook implementation that wakes an idle or terminal-state recipient session when a new agent_inbox message arrives, so org_send_message deliveries are never left unread.

nodes.name: AppHandleInboxWakeHook
nodes.summary: Tauri AppHandle-backed implementation of the InboxWakeHook trait used in production to dispatch inbox wake requests.

nodes.name: wake_one_member
nodes.summary: Core wake dispatch for a single member session: resolves session status, coalesces duplicate wake requests, and decides whether to enqueue, defer, or fail the wake based on run/session state.

nodes.name: wake_session
nodes.summary: Resolves the target session for a wake request (including redirecting to the correct recipient member) and drives the underlying wake-one-member flow.

nodes.name: manage_secrets.rs
nodes.summary: manage_secrets tool: lets the agent request a secret (API key, password, token) from the user via a frontend modal without the plaintext ever entering the LLM transcript, using an opaque {{secret:<token>}} placeholder resolved later by write_env_file.

nodes.name: SecretTool
nodes.summary: Tool implementation exposing the manage_secrets action set (request/list/discard) to the LLM, backed by SecretToolContext and the session's secret broker.

nodes.name: handle_request
nodes.summary: Handles the 'request' action: validates parameters, calls the secret broker to obtain a placeholder token for the requested secret, and returns the LLM-safe response.

nodes.name: manage_session.rs
nodes.summary: Unified session-management tool ('session') consolidating former session_create/session_monitor/session_intervene actions into one action-parameterized tool that routes through the frontend ActionBridge over Tauri IPC.

nodes.name: SessionTool
nodes.summary: Tool implementation dispatching manage_session actions (propose/create/list/status/rename/update_stats/intervene) to their handlers via the ActionBridge.

nodes.name: exec_create
nodes.summary: Handles the 'create' action: builds a session-creation request and awaits the frontend's ActionBridge response to spin up a new agent session.

nodes.name: exec_intervene
nodes.summary: Handles the 'intervene' action, the largest handler in the tool: sends an intervention request (e.g. pause/resume/redirect) for a running session through the ActionBridge and interprets the result.

nodes.name: member_idle.rs
nodes.summary: Production MemberIdleHook implementation that persists a MemberIdle envelope into the coordinator's agent_inbox when a worker session inside an AgentOrgRun finishes its turn idle.

nodes.name: InboxStoreMemberIdleHook
nodes.summary: InboxStoreMemberIdleHook implementation backed by AgentInboxStore that records member-idle notifications for the coordinator to read on its next turn.

nodes.name: post_member_idle
nodes.summary: Builds and persists the MemberIdle inbox message for the coordinator, then triggers a wake so the coordinator's next turn observes the idle worker.

nodes.name: member_shutdown.rs
nodes.summary: Production hooks that cancel a member session's runtime on shutdown acceptance and inject a MemberTerminated notification into the coordinator's inbox, plus a self-abort hook for members to cancel their own session.

nodes.name: AppHandleMemberShutdownHook
nodes.summary: AppHandle-backed MemberShutdownHook that cancels a member's runtime and wakes the coordinator when a shutdown response is accepted.

nodes.name: AppHandleSelfAbortHook
nodes.summary: AppHandle-backed hook allowing a member session to abort its own run and notify the org run of self-termination.

nodes.name: cancel_one
nodes.summary: Cancels a single member's session runtime and injects a MemberTerminated row into the coordinator's inbox so the coordinator's next turn is informed the worker is gone.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for agent orchestration tools (Delegate/Shadow dispatch, session lifecycle, interactive controls), re-exporting the agent, agent_org, ask_user_questions, channel, inbox_wake, manage_session, member_idle/shutdown, and suggest_mode_switch submodules.

nodes.name: broadcasting.rs
nodes.summary: TurnEventHandler wrapper (BroadcastingHandler) that forwards subagent turn events to both the inner UnifiedSubagentHandler and a channel sender, used to fan out live subagent output.

nodes.name: BroadcastingHandler
nodes.summary: Wraps a TurnEventHandler and an mpsc sender, forwarding every delta/tool-call/tool-result/completion event to both the inner handler and the channel.

nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: Builders for SessionEvent payloads (tool-call, streaming placeholder, tool-result) emitted by the unified subagent handler, plus streaming-placeholder flush logic.

nodes.name: build_tool_call_event
nodes.summary: Constructs a SessionEvent representing a tool call issued by a subagent, for persistence and live UI ingestion.

nodes.name: build_streaming_placeholder_event
nodes.summary: Builds a placeholder SessionEvent for in-progress streaming (message or thinking) content so the UI can render partial output before completion.

nodes.name: flush_streaming
nodes.summary: Swaps out any in-flight streaming placeholder for its finalized event when a stream segment completes.

nodes.name: build_tool_result_event
nodes.summary: Constructs a SessionEvent representing a tool result (including UI metadata) produced by a subagent tool call.

nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: Thin finalization helpers (broadcast_complete / broadcast_error) that end a subagent's turn-event lifecycle on the unified subagent handler.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines UnifiedSubagentHandler, the shared TurnEventHandler used by every delegate/subagent invocation so Tauri IPC events, SQLite persistence, live EventStore ingestion, and AwaitTool tailing all go through one implementation, split by concern across sibling submodules.

nodes.name: SubagentHandlerConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration bundle (parent/subagent session ids, description, agent type/name, instance number, parent call id) used to construct a UnifiedSubagentHandler.

nodes.name: UnifiedSubagentHandler
nodes.summary: Central TurnEventHandler implementation shared by all subagent/delegate invocations, tracking tool-call counts and elapsed time and dispatching to the persistence, store, events, and parent-stamp submodules.

nodes.name: parent_stamp.rs
nodes.summary: Stamps subagentSessionId and elapsedMs onto the parent agent's originating tool_call record so the parent transcript reflects the child subagent's identity and duration once it completes.

nodes.name: stamp_subagent_session_id_on_parent
nodes.summary: Writes the child subagent's session id back onto the parent's tool_call entry so the UI and transcript can correlate parent and child sessions.

nodes.name: stamp_elapsed_on_parent
nodes.summary: Records elapsed execution time on the parent's tool_call entry once the subagent finishes.

nodes.name: persistence.rs
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence helpers for the unified subagent handler: writes tool call/result rows, updates child session status, and hydrates the child session cache.

nodes.name: persist_child_session_to_cache
nodes.summary: Loads and caches the child subagent session's row so subsequent status/lookup calls avoid redundant SQLite reads.

nodes.name: store.rs
nodes.summary: Live EventStore integration for the unified subagent handler: pushes events, pins/unpins child sessions in the LRU, and toggles the child's streaming flag.

nodes.name: turn_handler.rs
nodes.summary: impl TurnEventHandler for UnifiedSubagentHandler: routes streaming deltas, tool calls/results, and iteration-complete callbacks to the handler's persistence, store, and events submodules.

nodes.name: on_tool_call
nodes.summary: TurnEventHandler callback invoked when the subagent issues a tool call; persists the call and pushes a live event to the store.

nodes.name: on_assistant_iteration_complete
nodes.summary: TurnEventHandler callback invoked at the end of each subagent turn iteration, finalizing streamed content and updating handler state.

nodes.name: subagent_wake.rs
nodes.summary: Process-wide hook (SubagentCompletionWakeHook, installed via OnceLock) that wakes an idle parent agent when a background subagent completes, preventing completed subagent output from being silently lost before the parent's next turn.

nodes.name: SubagentCompletionWakeHook
nodes.summary: Trait defining the wake_parent extension point invoked when a background subagent finishes, allowing the production AppHandle-backed hook or a no-op test hook to be installed.

nodes.name: AppHandleSubagentCompletionWakeHook
nodes.summary: Production AppHandle-backed implementation of SubagentCompletionWakeHook that dispatches a real wake to the parent session.

nodes.name: wake_parent_session
nodes.summary: Core logic resolving the parent session's status and dispatching the wake request so the parent picks up the completed subagent's output on its next turn.

nodes.name: suggest_mode_switch.rs
nodes.summary: suggest_mode_switch tool: called when the agent detects the user's intent would be better served in a different mode (e.g. Build to Plan); blocks until the user confirms the switch or skips it in the frontend.

nodes.name: ModeSwitchToolContext
nodes.summary: Per-session context (session id, mode manager, current mode) used by SuggestModeSwitchTool to evaluate and request mode switches.

nodes.name: SuggestModeSwitchTool
nodes.summary: Tool implementation exposing suggest_mode_switch to the LLM, blocking on the frontend's confirm/skip response before returning.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Executes the mode-switch suggestion flow: validates the target mode, prompts the frontend, and awaits/interprets the user's confirm-or-skip decision.

nodes.name: traits.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the base Tool trait implemented by every agent capability (name, description, JSON-schema parameters, execution, readiness, permission wiring, caching scope), the foundational abstraction for the entire tool system.
nodes.languageNotes: Encourages type-safe tool parameters via #[derive(Deserialize, JsonSchema)] param structs for automatic JSON Schema generation and compile-time validation instead of hand-written schemas.

nodes.name: Tool
nodes.summary: The base trait every agent tool implements: name/description/parameters/category, readiness checks, sync and async execution entry points, context wiring (session, repo, permissions), and schema/UI metadata hooks.

nodes.name: backoff.rs
nodes.summary: Constants and pure helper functions for the turn-executor's retry/backoff policy, centralizing magic numbers and the two pure helpers (cache_hit_rate, stream_backoff_ms) that drive the streaming retry loop in execute_turn.

nodes.name: stream_backoff_ms
nodes.summary: Computes the exponential backoff delay in milliseconds for a given retry attempt and stream-error kind.
